name: Diarrheal Disease
description: You die from severe dehydration caused by contaminated water.

name: Pneumonia
description: A respiratory infection overwhelms your small body.

name: Malaria
description: Despite fighting hard, the malaria was too severe.

name: Malnutrition/Starvation
description: There simply wasn't enough food. Your body gave out.

name: Congenital Birth Defect
description: You were born with a condition that couldn't be treated here.

name: Childhood Accident
description: A tragic accident. Drowning, fire, or fall. It happened so fast.

name: Preventable Disease
description: You died from something a vaccine could have prevented.

name: Maternal Death (Childbirth)
description: You died giving birth. Your child may or may not survive.

name: Violence (Armed Conflict)
description: You died in crossfire, shelling, or a raid. Wrong place, wrong time.

name: Homicide
description: You were killed by another person. Violence ended your life.

name: Traffic Accident
description: A vehicular accident took your life.

name: Suicide
description: The weight became too much. You took your own life.

name: Infectious Disease (HIV/TB)
description: A chronic infectious disease claimed you.

name: Heart Disease
description: Your heart gave out. A leading killer worldwide.

name: Cancer
description: Cancer spread through your body. Treatment wasn't enough, or wasn't available.

name: Stroke
description: A stroke took you suddenly.

name: Diabetes Complications
description: Diabetes-related complications ended your life.

name: Liver Disease (Alcohol)
description: Years of drinking destroyed your liver.

name: Drug Overdose
description: An overdose, accidental or intentional, ended your life.

name: Workplace Accident
description: A fatal accident at work. Safety regulations couldn't save you.

name: Dementia/Alzheimer's
description: Your mind faded first, then your body followed.

name: Pneumonia (Elderly)
description: Pneumonia, the old person's friend. You slipped away quietly.

name: Fall/Injury (Elderly)
description: A fall led to complications you couldn't recover from.

name: Old Age (Natural Causes)
description: Your body simply wore out. You lived a long life.

name: Natural Disaster
description: An earthquake, flood, hurricane, or other disaster claimed you.

name: Lack of Medical Care
description: You died from something treatable, but treatment was unavailable or unaffordable.

name: Childbirth Complications (Infant)
description: You died during or shortly after birth. Your mother may have died too.

name: HIV/AIDS
description: AIDS-related illness took you. Treatment was out of reach.

name: Tuberculosis
description: TB consumed your lungs over time.

name: Police/State Violence
description: You were killed by police or state security forces.
